title: DSLAB Project: Clusters Purity and CTGAN Generated Data
summary: A student data-science project that preprocesses an imbalanced financial-transactions/fraud dataset, builds pure and hybrid minority/majority clusters, and evaluates synthetic-vs-real data quality across many notebooks. It trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (with a custom row-level constraint) on the cluster datasets to generate synthetic fraud/non-fraud data, and uses sdmetrics functions to score similarity between real and synthetic clusters.
needs: the 'ctgan' directory is just a folder name for the notebook, not a vendored copy of the ctgan package
